entries.name: Wayfarer Iron Sword
entries.brief: upright narrow iron sword, bronze guard, brown leather grip

entries.name: Wayfarer Oak Shield
entries.brief: iron-rimmed round oak shield, muted moss-green center, bronze boss

entries.name: Wayfarer Iron Helm
entries.brief: empty open-face practical iron helmet

entries.name: Wayfarer Iron Cuirass
entries.brief: empty iron breastplate, leather shoulder straps and short waist plates

entries.name: Wayfarer Plated Gloves
entries.brief: pair of iron-plated brown leather gloves

entries.name: Wayfarer Reinforced Boots
entries.brief: pair of brown leather boots with iron reinforcements

entries.name: Threadkeeper Wand
entries.brief: upright slender ivory wand, copper spiral fitting, small turquoise tip

entries.name: Threadkeeper Focus
entries.brief: oval turquoise lens in copper cage on short ivory handle

entries.name: Threadkeeper Robe
entries.brief: empty long ivory linen robe, muted teal panels, narrow copper-gold embroidery

entries.name: Threadkeeper Hood
entries.brief: empty ivory and teal cloth hood, open dark center, copper clasp

entries.name: Threadkeeper Signet
entries.brief: copper signet ring with a turquoise enamel eye motif

entries.name: Threadkeeper Sash
entries.brief: wide horizontal ivory and teal woven waist belt, small copper buckle, no hanging tails

entries.name: Cinder Thread
entries.brief: single narrow orange fire dart with a long curling thread trail, diagonal rising motion
entries.game_description: A narrow fire projectile. Restore 3 mana when it hits a living enemy.

entries.name: Glacial Stitch
entries.brief: one sharp cyan ice needle crossing a small fractured frost star, precise piercing diagonal
entries.game_description: Pierce up to 3 enemies and slow 30% for 2s. Two hits within 6s freeze briefly; elites resist the duration.

entries.name: Arcane Fold
entries.brief: two offset violet doorway silhouettes connected by a sharply folded ribbon of space
entries.game_description: Blink up to 4 ground units onto valid floor. Invalid destinations do not spend mana or cooldown.

entries.name: Ashen Ward
entries.brief: golden shield-shaped rune enclosing a tiny ember with a clear dark open center
entries.game_description: Absorb incoming damage for 3s. This active ward does not heal or stack with itself.

entries.name: Starfall Script
entries.brief: one golden falling star striking a violet circular ground sigil, readable top-to-bottom motion
entries.game_description: Cast for 0.3s, then mark a circle that strikes after another 0.8s. Damage snapshots on activation.

entries.name: Solar Writ
entries.brief: a bright orange fan of flame spreading outward from a small golden sun disc
entries.game_description: A committed fire wave leaves a 3s burn. Direct damage and burn use the same spell-power snapshot.

entries.name: Winter Crown
entries.brief: three-point cyan crystalline crown above a broad circular frost nova
entries.game_description: A freezing nova stuns for 1s. Elite control duration is halved.

entries.name: Epoch Lance
entries.brief: one long violet-white lance passing diagonally through a silver hourglass ring
entries.game_description: A precise arcane lance pierces up to 3 enemies; each takes one hit.

entries.name: Echo Strike
entries.brief: two offset violet impact rings, the rear ring a pale ghost echo, strong concentric silhouettes
entries.game_description: A recovered memory strikes after 0.6s. Reach: 7 ground units.

entries.name: Winterglass Pulse
entries.brief: thick cyan circular ice pulse with four large outward ice shards
entries.game_description: A cold pulse stuns nearby enemies for 1.2s.

entries.name: Cinderwake
entries.brief: wide low orange fire cone sweeping outward from a glowing ember at its narrow end
entries.game_description: A Lorecasting training technique: scorch a cone and burn for 3s.

entries.name: Dawnfall
entries.brief: one vertical ivory-gold sunbeam striking a small golden ground ring, strong radiant pillar
entries.game_description: A large delayed radiant strike at the cursor. Reach: 7 units.

entries.name: Slash
entries.brief: one silver sword edge with a single short white slashing arc
entries.game_description: A swift sword strike. Restores 4 mana on the first successful hit.

entries.name: Cleave
entries.brief: one broad sweeping silver sword with a wide cool blue crescent trail
entries.game_description: A sweeping blow that strikes all enemies in front of you.

entries.name: Shield Charge
entries.brief: one silver kite shield moving diagonally forward with three bold blue motion strokes
entries.game_description: Charge toward the cursor, bashing every enemy in your path.

entries.name: Rallying Cry
entries.brief: one golden war horn with three widening amber sound arcs
entries.game_description: Restore 25% HP and gain 30% damage for 6s.

entries.name: Sundering Standard
entries.brief: one blue royal battle standard planted vertically into a cracked silver impact star
entries.game_description: A delayed standard strike at the cursor.

entries.name: Citadel Reprisal
entries.brief: one upright golden shield repelling three arrows radially outward with a pale gold pulse
entries.game_description: Repel enemies and recover 4% life per target hit.

entries.name: Furnace Sweep
entries.brief: one broad iron sword sweeping through a compact orange fan of furnace flame
entries.game_description: Sweep a fiery cone; burn for three seconds.

entries.name: Inventory
entries.brief: a small brown leather backpack with a brass buckle

entries.name: Character Sheet
entries.brief: an ivory parchment stat sheet behind a small silver helmet, no face or portrait

entries.name: Stash
entries.brief: a compact closed oak storage chest with iron corners and brass lock

entries.name: Merchant
entries.brief: small brass balance scale above two gold coins

entries.name: Blacksmith
entries.brief: a small dark iron anvil crossed by a copper forging hammer

entries.name: Pick Up Loot
entries.brief: an open ivory gloved hand lifting one gold coin

entries.name: Transfer Item
entries.brief: two small leather pouches connected by two bold opposing brass arrows

entries.name: Equip Item
entries.brief: one upright silver sword entering an outlined equipment socket, small gold upward arrow

entries.name: Compare Gear
entries.brief: two small contrasting silver and bronze shields side by side with a narrow center divider

entries.name: Inspect Item
entries.brief: one brass magnifying glass over a small blue crystal set in a ring

entries.name: Interact
entries.brief: an open ivory glove with raised index finger inside a simple open brass circle

billing_note: Higgsfield submissions rejected by account concurrency before creating any jobs; no paid fallback. All seven new source sheets came from OpenAI image_gen.
